machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All six objectives are complete and each was verified against the live page. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Customer `fwod53-n1 Bench Customer` created and saved; verified on the Sales > Customers kanban where its card shows exactly "fwod53-n1 Bench Customer" with City "Benchville".

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Draft quotation created for that customer with one order line. Product chosen: **[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens** (selected from the product autocomplete dropdown). Unit price auto-filled by the app: **£ 295.00**. Untaxed Amount computed: **£ 885.00** (3 × 295; TAX 20% £ 177.00, Total £ 1,062.00). Quotation reference: **S00021**.

**Objective 3 — DONE:** Second order line added with a different product: **[E-COM11] Cabinet with Doors** (chosen from the dropdown), quantity 2, unit price £ 140.00, line subtotal £ 280.00. New Untaxed Amount: **£ 1,165.00** (TAX 20% £ 233.00, Total £ 1,398.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE:** First line's quantity changed from 3 to **5.00** (line subtotal became £ 1,475.00; second line untouched at 2 × £ 140.00 = £ 280.00). Untaxed Amount afterwards: **£ 1,755.00** (TAX 20% £ 351.00, Total £ 2,106.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Quotation confirmed via the Confirm button (no dialog appeared). Order reference: **S00021**. Status shown in the statusbar: **"Sales Order"** (the Quotation Template field and Confirm button disappeared, a Create Invoice button appeared; Untaxed Amount still £ 1,755.00).

**Objective 6 — DONE:** Sales order cancelled. The header Cancel button opened a "Cancel Sales Order" wizard; I clicked its "Cancel" action button (not "Send and cancel", so no email was sent to the customer). Status shown afterwards: **"Cancelled"** (statusbar radios: Cancelled [current] / Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation; a "Set to Quotation" button now appears). Reference still **S00021**, amounts unchanged (£ 1,755.00 untaxed).

Nothing created by this run remains active: the only order, S00021, is in Cancelled state, and no invoice was ever created.
